verdict.rationale: First-party docs say every email needing a reply gets an auto-draft "written in your voice" that you can edit and send. Superhuman AI matches the voice and tone of your sent emails, adapts style per recipient, and accepts plain-language writing instructions. Drafts also pull context from your inbox, calendar, and the web, so they go beyond boilerplate. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that drafts actually sound like the user (all evidence is vendor-claimed).
